action.command: export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && nohup /opt/android-sdk/emulator/emulator -avd umweltnavi_avd -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot > /tmp/emu2.log 2>&1 & echo "emu pid $!" && for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 15; state=$(/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb devices 2>/dev/null | grep -c "emulator-5554.*device$"); [ "$state" = "1" ] && break; done; /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb devices; /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed
